PRIVACY & ANALYTICS

Website privacy and analytics

Last updated: 30 October 2026.

Who manages this website?

CurveMole is an open-source project maintained by Sebastiano Romi. For privacy questions or data-protection requests, contact romi@lens.unifi.it.

Hosting and technical data

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may process technical information necessary to deliver the website, independently of our web analytics. Read GitHub's privacy statement.

Website analytics

We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand aggregate page views, visitor trends and website performance. This analytics service does not use analytics cookies or fingerprint individual visitors. Cloudflare states that Web Analytics does not collect or use visitors' personal data or track individuals across websites. We do not use these statistics for targeted advertising.

Your browser loads the analytics script from static.cloudflareinsights.com and sends measurement requests to cloudflareinsights.com. Like other network requests, these connections necessarily expose technical request information to the recipient. See Cloudflare's data collection documentation and privacy policy for more information.

Cookies and consent

CurveMole does not set cookies for analytics. The previous Google Analytics integration has been removed and no analytics consent preference is stored by this site. Cookie-free, aggregated Web Analytics can operate without a cookie consent banner, subject to applicable privacy requirements. External sites you visit by following links from CurveMole have their own privacy practices.

Your rights and contact

For questions about data processing, or to exercise applicable privacy rights, contact romi@lens.unifi.it.
